remarks: Experience the ultimate waterfront lifestyle at Norwalk Harborview Condominiums! This rarely available end unit boasts panoramic water views, unforgettable sunsets, and your very own boat slip-a true boater's dream! Step into an updated, sun-drenched home featuring gleaming tile and hardwood floors throughout, designed to maximize natural light and showcase the stunning harborfront scenery from every angle. The open-concept living and dining area flows effortlessly onto a private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails while watching the boats glide by. The spacious primary suite is a serene retreat with a fully refreshed en-suite bath, while a second full bathroom off the hall ensures comfort for guests. The versatile second bedroom can easily be a home office and also includes balcony access for added inspiration. Ideally located just a short stroll to vibrant waterfront restaurants and under a mile from the East Norwalk Train Station, this condo blends coastal tranquility with commuter convenience. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live on the water with all the comforts of a modern, move-in ready home! Assessment going towards capital fund of $539.12/mo.
